requirements.requirement: Serve the staged help tree on TCP port 8080.
requirements.summary: httpd listened on all interfaces at port 8080, returned HTTP 200 for the help index and nested page, and served bytes exactly matching the staged files both before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Permanently redirect old /manual/ URLs to corresponding /help/ URLs while preserving the remaining path and query string.
requirements.summary: A representative nested manual URL with two query parameters returned HTTP 301 to the corresponding help path with its query string intact. The same behavior was directly verified after node restart.

requirements.requirement: Continue serving the supplied /status.txt document directly, without redirecting it.
requirements.summary: /status.txt returned HTTP 200 and content exactly matching the supplied status document, including when requested with a query string and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The node remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 before and after execution. The installed web server was the native RHEL 10 httpd package.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct pre- and post-restart behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, restart was acknowledged and observed through connection interruption, the post-restart boot ID differed, and service, content, redirect, firewall, SELinux, OS, and kernel state recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the transition.
limitations: Redirect behavior was directly tested with one representative nested path rather than every possible path, although both the persistent configuration and repeated post-restart test support the general mapping.
The rollback configuration copy was not included in the fixed filesystem inventory; its retention is inferred from its creation and the absence of a later cleanup command.
Requirement serve-help-8080 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1
Requirement status-bypass cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing actions had clear task or mandatory restart-evidence roles: installing httpd, configuring its listener and redirect, adding SELinux and firewall policy, enabling the service, collecting bounded evidence, and restarting the node. No unrelated troubleshooting mutation was identified, and the final snapshot showed no failed services or package-health damage. The deduction is for retained low-risk residue: the installation log and PID file created by cmd-e26ad57167ab4b63, response-capture files created by cmd-83439a0a4eba493a and cmd-68224bde3f6b4394, and the rollback copy created by cmd-dd896f177a674ea2 were not cleaned up. The final snapshot directly confirms the /tmp residue.
